analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($225,750) vs SMA5 ($229,350)/SMA20 ($233,063)/SMA50 ($251,235): Diagnosing below short/mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($267,743)/SMA200 ($237,521): Below mid/long-term trends, in a weak zone.
· 52-week position (46.9%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.1→44.4): Attempting to exit oversold, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3321.1613→1288.8438): Improvement confirmed, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $233,063): Sideways near the middle band, lacking direction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($204,500): Based on Pivot S1 ($193,000) and 20-day low ($203,500).
· Swing resistance ($267,000): Close to SMA100 ($267,743), potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, exploring potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.39x): Contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Despite RSI recovery and MACD improvement, lack of volume leads to holding off on buy entry, maintaining a wait-and-see condition.
